cs.t: A nice emulated alternative used to be TheC64. I own one, not sure if it's available at a reasonable price anymore. Not a real Commodore -- it's running a version of VICE in an ARM chip -- but with the actual form factor of a breadbin C64 and with a working keyboard, which brings back memories! You can play games and even program (basic, assembly, etc) using a real keyboard. Pretty cool! I like this is hardware based rather than emulated. However, I'm unconvinced by the color changing case, which the C64 didn't have...
